summary: Rendered wave attempt g3c2a80scale0p5-20260908j used reference-binding stem tokens that produced 65-character Job metadata names; Kubernetes rejects Job names above 63 characters via the auto-injected job-name pod label, so kubectl create returned partial Invalid errors and zero jobs landed.
root_cause: render_v4_horizontal_g3_k8s_jobs.py stem used full fixture token reference-binding with a 26-character attempt_id, yielding v4-g3-reference-binding-g3c2a80scale0p5-20260908j-{hash}-sNNN names longer than the 63-character Kubernetes metadata.name limit.
remediation: Shortened k8s stem alias to rb via FIXTURE_K8S_STEM_ALIASES, added fail-closed assert_k8s_metadata_name validation before bundle write, and re-dispatched wave attempt g3rb20260908k through gated dispatch.
